text:
Asha (Marketing): Quick check-in: final blog draft attached. Need legal wording on the cost stat, confirm webinar co-presenter, and inbound routing for registrants. Target publish Fri 5/10.

Asha (Marketing): Hero draft: "Ship LLM features with sub-150ms 95th percentile latency on typical prompts (<=512 tokens) and lowers estimated serving costs by up to 3x in our internal benchmark (see methodology)."

Kai (Product): Love it. For the bench line in the body can we say: "In internal tests, batching + KV cache lowered median token serving cost ~3x for small-batch chat workloads." I'll add the mini chart.

Drew (Sales Ops): Routing: HubSpot form should include hidden fields account_size, company_size, region, pql_score. If account_size=enterprise then assign owner via sales_escalation_team and post to #sales-inbound. Also set lead_priority=high for webinar attendees.

Elena (Growth): A/B idea: Variant A gated webinar form (full fields), Variant B lightweight registration (email only) to see conversion vs MQL quality. Add utm_campaign=demo_series1 and utm_content=hero_v1/v2. I'll set 60/40 favoring gated for first week.

Nora (Legal): We can't use exact multipliers without methodology and sample size. Change "up to 3x" to "up to 3x in our internal benchmark; see methodology for details." Also add footnote: "Estimate based on X runs across Y models; results may vary." Approve after edit.

Asha (Marketing): OK will change to that phrasing and attach methodology link + footnote. Also planning webinar co-presenter: Kai + Riley from Solutions. Can Sales confirm demo itinerary (5-7 min demo, 15 min Q&A)?

Drew (Sales Ops): Confirmed. Add demo tag in HubSpot and set notify_webhook=sales_alerts for enterprise leads.

Kai (Product): Demo plan approved. I'll provide the live latency graph and a recorded clip for the blog embed.

Elena (Growth): I'll set experiment: 60/40 for 48h then re-balance. Track MQL rate, demo attend rate, and SQL handoffs. Tag utm_content accordingly.

DeployBot: Created publish slot: job_id=pub_20260510_0800 status=waiting_on_legal.

Asha (Marketing): Nora please react "ok" when you paste final footnote text. Drew/Elena please confirm routing links. Need thumbs by 3pm PT.

Nora (Legal): ok — footnote: "Methodology: internal benchmark ran N=30 prompt traces across 3 model variants on Tesla-A100 hardware. Reported reductions are estimates and subject to workload variance."

Drew (Sales Ops): routing confirmed. #sales-inbound webhook set.

Elena (Growth): experiment configured; will post dashboard link.

Asha (Marketing): Thanks — locking copy and scheduling. Will post final blog URL and publish confirmation here.
